data.gender_notes: Audley is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English elements 'ead' (wealth, fortune) and 'leah' (wood, clearing), Audley means 'powerful ruler in a clearing'. This name was common during the Middle Ages in England, especially among the nobility. The name Audley carries the meaning “Powerful ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Audley usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reminding us of the power and wisdom of God, guiding us as a ruler in our own lives.
data.etymology: Audley belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Audley total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
